FN-B2XKQJ4-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 92
Committee: Ports, Waterways & Intermodal Transit Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/11/2025
House Bill 92 as introduced would increase the obligation of the Dauphin Island Sea Lab by an
undetermined amount provide administrative support to the Alabama Seagrass Restoration Task
Force created by this bill. These obligations may be offset in part or in whole by the retention of
funds appropriated for administrative costs expended by the sea lab pursuant to the provisions of
this bill.
